ingredients.name: littleneck clams
ingredients.preparation: scrubbed, any that are open and do not close when tapped discarded

steps.title: Scrub and boil
steps.body: Scrub the clams. Slice the garlic, chop the parsley, and juice the lemon. Put a large pot of water on to boil and salt it. The water should be boiling by the end of this 15-minute prep.

steps.title: Pasta and clams
steps.body: Boil the linguine until it is almost tender, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile warm the olive oil, garlic, and red pepper flakes in a skillet over medium until the garlic is fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the wine and the clams, cover, and cook until the clams open, about 6 to 8 minutes. Discard any that stay shut.

steps.title: Toss
steps.body: Drain the pasta, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water. Toss the pasta with the clams, their liquor, the parsley, lemon juice, and pepper. Loosen with pasta water if it looks dry. Cook is 18 minutes.
